---
title: "Dr. Susan Rumisha"
---

**Principal Research Scientist; Lead, Malaria Atlas Project (MAP) Dar es Salaam Node, Ifakara Health Institute**

Dr. Rumisha specializes in developing geospatial analytical frameworks for
malaria, with a focus on producing malaria risk maps, estimating disease
burden, and evaluating malaria health systems. She is driven by the use of
data-driven evidence to strengthen malaria decision-making.

She is affiliated with the National Institute for Medical Research (NIMR)
in Tanzania, the Telethon Kids Institute, and Curtin University in Perth,
WA, Australia.
